scope: Exactly the prior 39 deterministic CLI cases at both pinned gates (78 runs), with newly required clean source_binding generated BEFORE each mutation at BOTH pins; no added cases. Pinned ledger, report binding and 20-file inventory checks. No models, candidate execution, Monte Carlo, raw changes or remote PID inference.

fixture_contract.required_augmentation: All clean branch baselines for BOTH gate versions receive the same positive one-episode report, now including branch-side match count and source_binding for original branch/log/visible-test bytes and covered IDs. Mutation occurs afterward; the old parent-hash counterexample retains the now-stale report. This is synthetic fixture evidence, not claimed reconstruction of its dummy transcript.
fixture_contract.recovery: Both versions reject unledgered history and should accept the separate valid ledgered adaptive recovery case.
fixture_contract.report_negatives: Both versions require a positive report; missing and disagreement cases retain expected rejection.

published_tests.note: Executed separately against the pinned gate/test checkout; this audit script does not rerun those tests or reproduce the claimed full 97-test suite.

report.method: transcript rebuilt from the frozen task file, frozen certified visible tests and the parent's recorded stage-0 reply and trace; hashed and compared with the hash the parent logged before its own t=1 model call. No model or candidate code was executed.
report.caveat: this verifies the recorded transcript hash and the stored flag. It does not re-execute the tool, so `tool_result_reproduced` is reported as stored, not independently recomputed.

actual_report_binding.note: Hashes and ID coverage independently checked against pinned bytes. Recomputed parent/branch transcript counts remain the helper report here; full reconstruction is separate work.

report_binding.mechanism: Re-derives branch/log/visible-test byte hashes and covered-ID digest; requires aggregate branch-side match count. Gate checks the report rather than invoking reconstruction.

helper.mechanism: Rebuilds parent pre-t=1 transcript, compares parent and branch fork-decision transcript hashes, and binds three input files plus covered IDs. Tool-result fidelity remains a stored flag.

invocation_source.mechanism: Completed episode source hash must match a nonempty code_sha256 recorded under its own invocation. All-manifest-missing source hashes reject.

limits: Input/template coverage: the restoration source_binding omits loaded task-file bytes, agent prompt/repair template source and verifier implementation. Configuration metadata is separately checked by the gate. The helper imports current agent functions; the gate does not reconstruct transcripts or tie this computation to a pinned verifier/template revision.

Source identity scope: per-invocation episode/manifest hash consistency is checked, not recomputation against an archived executable source bundle. A runtime source mismatch cannot be inferred from consistency of these two recorded values alone.

Durable scope: restoration binding covers completed episode files, not branch/log decisions.jsonl. The stage gate matches durable keys and actions, but does not compare their transcript_sha256 or all state/probability fields to nested records. No corrupt archived row is alleged; this is an unimplemented generic check identified from source.

The report remains a computed artifact, not a cryptographic attestation or atomic snapshot. Actual-host writer exclusion, atomic publication, tool re-execution and lost-call completion are outside these checks.

interpretation: All three previously accepted bounded cases now reject: changing branch hash while retaining its old report, borrowing a source hash only from another invocation, and omitting all manifest source hashes. All 39 case expectations are met at the new pin, including valid clean log/branch and ledgered adaptive recovery.

The clean report was bound before mutation at both pins. This verifies stale-report rejection without masking the earlier parent-hash defect by refreshing its binding after the mutation. The new helper branch-side comparison is inspected in source; this audit does not regenerate the scientific restoration report.
All 20 non-analysis files and the five historical durable rows/four ledger IDs are unchanged. Actual saved report hashes and 800 covered IDs independently agree with pinned records.

The remaining input/template/durable limits describe generic checker coverage, not detected corruption, new empirical evidence, or re-opening the three fixes. No broader adversarial search was performed.
Published 42-test suite and 78 isolated CLI runs are deterministic checks. Reported full-suite 97 passes and experiment-host liveness were not independently reproduced here.
